scene_order_rule: These8 sequences first in listed order; remaining42 in lexicographic order. Freeze before inference; preflight is the prefix of the formal run.
common_checks: finite float outputs and nonempty PNGs
filename focus exactly matches prepared geometry
no GT mask supplied to model
40 fixed keyframe groups reviewed for implementation errors, not model quality

any2bokeh.input: Unmodified author WholeVid loader on original JPEG RGB and original-size prepared PNG8 VDA q. No mask_folder is provided.
any2bokeh.resize: Author pixel_transforms and MPI resize; CoC/MPI built at source resolution before resize
any2bokeh.rng: Global torch seed0 before model loading; CPU generator seed0 per public pipeline call. VAE latent sampling also advances global RNG; save/restore CPU+CUDA state at scene boundaries for prefix reuse.
any2bokeh.output: Author postprocessed float, finite check, clamp/round RGB PNG8; existing project output convention

frame_methods.RGB_resize: cv2.INTER_LINEAR original JPEG to1024x576, uint8 then RGB float32/255; same declared resize as DeepLens DAVIS
frame_methods.disparity_resize: cv2.INTER_LINEAR on float64 q/255 to1024x576; no second PNG quantization; focus remains the prepared source-resolution five-decimal scalar

bokehdiff.rng: One global seed before model loading, never per-frame/per-scene reset. Same public per-call scheduler generator as Track A. Resume CPU+CUDA state after prefix; formal42 scenes continue after preflight8 in the declared DAVIS manifest order.
bokehdiff.scope: Track A model/PISA/seed policy unchanged; its separate Synthetic candidate runs are untouched. DAVIS explicitly uses one shared preflight-to-formal stream to make reuse valid.

limits: Model failures are retained unless an objective implementation error blocks the protocol
Shared external sources do not imply identical internal CoC or resize kernels
Formal all-method sweep starts after all five preflights and fixed visual reviews pass
